claims: One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards in March 2026.
Paul Thomas Anderson directed One Battle After Another.
One Battle After Another stars Leonardo DiCaprio.
One Battle After Another is a satirical thriller.
One Battle After Another won Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Best Adapted Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sara Murphy and Adam Somner are producers of One Battle After Another.
The other nominees for Best Picture at the 2026 Oscar were Sinners, Hamnet, Sentimental Value, The Secret Agent, Bugonia, Marty Supreme, Frankenstein, F1, and Train Dreams.
